title: Announcing Whalesync in the HubSpot App Marketplace
summary: Whalesync is now in the HubSpot App Marketplace
body_markdown:
Good news for HubSpot users… Whalesync is now listed in the HubSpot App Marketplace!


This inclusion reflects our ongoing effort to bridge HubSpot with other applications seamlessly.


You can check out our official listing[here](https://app.hubspot.com/ecosystem/39783432/marketplace/apps/productivity/connector/whalesync) .
